19.issue_summary: ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION and ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION are declared for every Android version, although the code only needs location below Android 13.
19.evidence: AndroidManifest.xml lines 11-16 declare ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION and ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION with android:required="true" and no android:maxSdkVersion. GamesFragment.kt line 50 uses NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES on API 33+ and ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION only below it, and manifest lines 9-10 already mark NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES as neverForLocation. So on Android 13+ the location permissions are declared but never requested or needed. A downgrade to COARSE alone is not an option, because Wi-Fi Direct needs FINE below API 33. No location API (LocationManager, FusedLocation, getLastKnownLocation, requestLocationUpdates), SSID read or IP geo-lookup was found in the source, so this is excess declared scope, not location collection.
19.recommendation: Add android:maxSdkVersion="32" to both location <uses-permission> entries and drop android:required="true", so the permissions apply only to Android 12/12L (minSdk is 31). Check the merged release manifest afterwards to confirm no other module or library declares them without the limit.
